title: Himeji tourism bureau — rail arrival and local transport

facts.fact: JR Himeji has Shinkansen and conventional-rail approaches, while Sanyo Himeji is a different arrival station served by Sanyo Electric Railway.
The official transport guide describes local Shinki buses and a castle-area loop, plus taxi stands north and south of JR Himeji; schedules/fares should be checked with the carrier.
